summary: The TDD phase of cycle 2515 gave AC 1b of handoff-judge-one-seat-walker the console-followup disposition. A lane builder can never change the paths it needs (.evolve/policy.json, .evolve/profiles/handoff-judge.json, go/internal/core/handoff_judge.go, go/cmd/evolve/handoff_judge.go). The lane part ships without it, so the console owns this part.
